concerns.text: T003 aborts if `data/raw/commit_pairs.csv` already exists, which can prevent the pipeline from ever reaching the required ≥ 500 valid pairs on subsequent runs, weakening FR‑001 and SC‑001.
T004 records Cohen’s κ but does not enforce the required κ ≥ 0.6 before downstream steps; the fallback path allows the pipeline to continue with κ < 0.6, violating FR‑008.
No task is defined to run the Reference‑Validator agent on citations, breaching Constitution II (Verified Accuracy).
T013 updates checksums but never updates the project’s `state/projects/PROJ-104‑…yaml` `updated_at` timestamp, violating Constitution V (Versioning Discipline).

The specification names LLM models with capitalized hyphenated forms (e.g., “Phi‑3‑mini”) while tasks and schemas use lowercase IDs (e.g., “phi3‑mini”), creating a traceability mismatch that can cause FR‑002 to be unmet.
